name: Pennsylvania Native Plant Society Native Plant Habitat Restoration & Creation Grant
summary: Small grants for groups installing or restoring native plant gardens or woodlands on publicly accessible sites in Pennsylvania. Applicants must be PNPS members.
reporting: Project updates during the grant year and a final report by 1 September.

eligibility.rule: Have active PNPS membership, unless a student
Use 100% Pennsylvania native plant species, with at least 70% straight species
Locate project areas in publicly accessible spaces
Wait two years after receiving funding before applying again
Use no salaries, overhead, or non-native plant materials

documents: Project timeline within the grant year
Signed and dated landowner permission letter, if applicable

applicant_types.quote: We give small grants to groups working on projects focused on outreach, education, and research related to native plants.

geography.quote: supports projects that advance the conservation, study, and appreciation of native plants and native plant habitats across Pennsylvania.

access.quote: You must be a PNPS member to submit a grant application.

window.quote: Applications open: January 15 Applications close: February 15

amount.quote: Grant awards typically range from $500 to $1,500, with a maximum award of $1,500 per project.

reporting.quote: Grant recipients are required to submit project updates during the grant year and a final report by September 1.

effort.quote: Applications must be submitted in full by the deadline to be considered.

eligibility.quote: All projects must use 100% Pennsylvania native plant species, with at least 70% straight species (limited cultivars).
Project areas must be located in publicly accessible spaces.
Previous recipients of a PNPS Annual Grant are required to wait two years after receiving funding before applying again.
Funds may not be used for salaries, overhead, or non-native plant materials.
